how_to_apply: Obtain a mandatory referral/request letter from your college's Principal/Director, on college letterhead, recommending you as a meritorious student for the DRDL Paid Internship Scheme.

Fill out the application form as per the official format (Name, Date of Birth, Aadhaar Number, College details, Discipline, Branch Code, Degree/Semester/Year, % Marks/CGPA, Achievements, Languages Known, Referral Letter, Address, Contact details).

Walk in and submit the completed application in an envelope at the registration desk, clearly marking the envelope "Application for Paid Internship" and mentioning the relevant Branch Code (EE/ME/PH/CS).
Also forward a scanned copy of the application to: [email protected]
Ensure your application reaches by the last date of 16th August 2026 (tentative).
Wait for shortlisting intimation via phone and the DRDO website for the interview.
There is no online application portal for this internship; candidates must apply through the walk-in process along with the email submission described above.
important_instructions: Candidates should make their own arrangements for stay and transport in Hyderabad, and should be prepared to stay for one or more days depending on the number of candidates attending the walk-in interview. No boarding or lodging expenses are admissible; only subsidised canteen facilities are available at DRDL/ASL/CAS. The referral letter from the Principal/Director of the college/institute is mandatory for the application to be considered. Shortlisted candidates must bring a character certificate from their college and a police verification certificate to the interview. The laboratory (DRDL/ASL/CAS) will not be responsible for any injuries sustained during the internship period. This internship does not create any obligation on DRDL/ASL/CAS to offer future employment, nor can interns claim any employment right based on completing the internship. Selection is entirely merit-based; rejected candidates will not receive any individual communication.

content_sections.heading: DRDL Paid Internship 2026 Eligibility
content_sections.text: Candidates must be pursuing their final year of Undergraduate Engineering, OR Candidates must be pursuing their final year of Postgraduate Engineering or Physical Science. The course must be a full-time programme in the respective discipline from a recognised Indian University/Institute, approved by AICTE/UGC. content_sections.heading: DRDL Paid Internship 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Application Submission: Candidates submit a physical application (in an envelope) at the walk-in registration desk, along with a scanned copy sent by email. Shortlisting: Based on academic percentage/CGPA (converted to percentage) and the mandatory college referral letter. Interaction/Interview: Shortlisted candidates are called for an interaction/interview at DRDL/ASL/CAS, Hyderabad. Final Selection: Made entirely on merit basis. No communication will be sent to rejected candidates. The management reserves the right to change the vacancy positions or selection criteria at any point during the selection process, without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: DRDL Paid Internship 2026 Required Documents
content_sections.text: Selected students must submit the following documents at the time of joining: No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the college, in original, on college letterhead, confirming relief for the internship and a minimum of 15 working days' presence per month. Police verification acknowledgement from the local police station. Undertaking for adherence to the Indian Official Secrets Act, 1923. Undertaking to follow IT rules and regulations applicable to the Ministry of Defence. Bank account details for transfer of the internship stipend. Medical fitness certificate from an authorised medical practitioner holding at least an MBBS degree. Original Aadhaar card and college ID card, for verification at the time of joining. 3 passport-size photographs. All previous semester mark sheets in original, for on-the-spot verification (returned immediately after verification). Indemnity form, to be provided by the college as and when required by DRDL/ASL/CAS. Character certificate from the college, and police verification certificate, to be brought by shortlisted candidates at the time of the walk-in.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DRDL Paid Internship 2026
content_sections.text: Obtain a mandatory referral/request letter from your college's Principal/Director, on college letterhead, recommending you as a meritorious student for the DRDL Paid Internship Scheme. Fill out the application form as per the official format (Name, Date of Birth, Aadhaar Number, College details, Discipline, Branch Code, Degree/Semester/Year, % Marks/CGPA, Achievements, Languages Known, Referral Letter, Address, Contact details). Walk in and submit the completed application in an envelope at the registration desk, clearly marking the envelope "Application for Paid Internship" and mentioning the relevant Branch Code (EE/ME/PH/CS). Also forward a scanned copy of the application to: [email protected] Ensure your application reaches by the last date of 16th August 2026 (tentative). Wait for shortlisting intimation via phone and the DRDO website for the interview. There is no online application portal for this internship; candidates must apply through the walk-in process along with the email submission described above.

content_sections.heading: DRDL Paid Internship 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates should make their own arrangements for stay and transport in Hyderabad, and should be prepared to stay for one or more days depending on the number of candidates attending the walk-in interview. No boarding or lodging expenses are admissible; only subsidised canteen facilities are available at DRDL/ASL/CAS. The referral letter from the Principal/Director of the college/institute is mandatory for the application to be considered. Shortlisted candidates must bring a character certificate from their college and a police verification certificate to the interview. The laboratory (DRDL/ASL/CAS) will not be responsible for any injuries sustained during the internship period. This internship does not create any obligation on DRDL/ASL/CAS to offer future employment, nor can interns claim any employment right based on completing the internship. Selection is entirely merit-based; rejected candidates will not receive any individual communication.

faq.question: Q1. What is DRDL Paid Internship 2026?
faq.answer: It is a 6-month paid internship scheme (Advt. No. DRDL/HRD/INTERNSHIP/2026/01) by Defence Research and Development Laboratory, Hyderabad, for final-year Engineering and Physical Science UG/PG students, offering practical exposure to missile systems and defence R&D work.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DRDL Internship 2026?
faq.answer: There are 165 indicative positions across four branches: EE (58), ME (87), PH (05), and CS (15). The number may increase or decrease at the establishment's discretion.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for DRDL Paid Internship 2026?
faq.answer: The tentative last date for filling applications is 16th August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the eligibility for DRDL Paid Internship?
faq.answer: Candidates must be pursuing their final year of Undergraduate Engineering, or final year Postgraduate in Engineering/Physical Science, full-time, from an AICTE/UGC-approved institute, with a minimum of 60% marks or equivalent CGPA.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for DRDL Paid Internship 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be below 28 years of age.

faq.question: Q6. What is the stipend for DRDL Paid Internship 2026?
faq.answer: The stipend is ₹5,000 per month, paid in two installments, with the first installment released after 3 months of training, subject to a minimum of 15 working days' attendance per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for DRDL Paid Internship 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through shortlisting based on academic percentage/CGPA and a mandatory college referral letter, followed by a walk-in interaction/interview. Final selection is entirely merit-based.

faq.question: Q8. Is there an online application for DRDL Internship 2026?
faq.answer: No. Candidates must submit a physical application at the walk-in registration desk along with a scanned copy emailed to [email protected]. There is no online application portal.

faq.question: Q9. Will DRDL offer a job after the internship?
faq.answer: No. The laboratory has no obligation to offer employment to interns, and interns cannot claim any right to employment on the basis of completing the internship.

faq.question: Q10. Is a college referral letter mandatory for DRDL Internship 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. A referral/request letter from the Principal/Director of the candidate's college or institution, on college letterhead, is mandatory for the application to be considered.
